next.reason: 1985: 'After the execution of imperative-statement-1 in the AT END phrase, no RETURN statement may be executed as part of the current output procedure.'; 2023: 'If such a RETURN statement is executed, the EC-SORT-MERGE-RETURN exception condition is set to exist and the results of the execution of the RETURN statement are undefined.'. Next-record, AT END transfer and undefined record area are the same. 1985 only forbids a RETURN after AT END; 2023 also defines the effect: EC-SORT-MERGE-RETURN is set.
